bubbles.title: Installer to dist
bubbles.hint: tsconfig.install.json outDir install/ -> dist/install/ (still committed); install.js, build.test, anything resolving paths from __dirname

bubbles.title: Site build to dist
bubbles.hint: .site-build/ -> dist/site/ (ignored); build.mts paths, npm run site, .gitignore

bubbles.title: Pages to dist
bubbles.hint: _site/ -> dist/pages/ (ignored; CI builds it): build.mts default, pages.yml path, .gitignore, READMEs, AGENTS.md, main.mts message

bubbles.title: Installer out of dist
bubbles.hint: dist/ is fully git-ignored now, so the committed installer goes back to install/: tsconfig.install.json, io.ts REPO, install.js, build.test, README, AGENTS.md

bubbles.title: Hooks into manifest
bubbles.hint: plugin.json back to .claude-plugin/plugin.json (the only place Claude Code reads it); fog-gate hook inline there; drop hooks/; manifest test checks the hook script exists
